sloka: भरतस्य वचः श्रुत्वा धैर्यशौर्यसमन्वितम् ।लक्ष्मणावरजस्तस्थौ हित्वा सौवर्णमासनम् ।। ७.६२.१० ॥
transliteration: bharatasya vacaḥ śrutvā dhairyaśauryasamanvitam ।lakṣmaṇāvarajastasthau hitvā sauvarṇamāsanam ।। 7.62.10 ॥

translations.english: Having heard Bharata's words, which were full of courage and valor, Shatrughna, Lakshmana's younger brother, stood up, leaving his golden seat.
